# What `nft list ruleset` (nftables 1.1.3) prints after deploy/nftables/carnical.nft is loaded in a private network namespace
# (unshare -Urn), with the service users written as uids 990 (the edge) and 991-994, since they do not exist there.
# Regenerate it when carnical.nft changes; TestNFTListingMatchesTheRulesetFile says when.
table inet carnical {
	counter edge_bad_source {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_bad_tcp {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_udp_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_syn_global_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_syn_source_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_syn_admitted {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_syn_peer_admitted {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_syn_peer_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter input_denied {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter input_logged {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_discovery_accept {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_echo_admitted {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter edge_echo_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter egress_private_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter egress_imds_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter egress_edge_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	counter egress_internal_drop {
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	set syn4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65536
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set syn6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		size 65536
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set edge_peers4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
	}

	set edge_peers6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
	}

	set syn_peer4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 4096
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set syn_peer6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		size 4096
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set not_public4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 0.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8,
			     100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8,
			     168.63.129.16, 169.254.0.0/16,
			     172.16.0.0/12, 192.0.0.0/24,
			     192.168.0.0/16, 198.18.0.0/15,
			     224.0.0.0/4, 240.0.0.0/4 }
	}

	set not_public6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { ::,
			     ::1,
			     64:ff9b::/96,
			     100::/64,
			     2002::/16,
			     fc00::/7,
			     fe80::/10,
			     ff00::/8 }
	}

	chain edge_prerouting {
		type filter hook prerouting priority raw; policy accept;
		iifname "lo" return
		fib daddr type != local return
		udp dport 443 counter name "edge_udp_drop" drop
		tcp dport 443 jump edge_tcp
	}

	chain edge_tcp {
		ip saddr { 0.0.0.0/8, 127.0.0.0/8, 224.0.0.0/3 } counter name "edge_bad_source" drop
		ip6 saddr { ::/127, ff00::/8 } counter name "edge_bad_source" drop
		tcp flags & (fin | syn) == fin | syn counter name "edge_bad_tcp" drop
		tcp flags & (syn | rst) == syn | rst counter name "edge_bad_tcp" drop
		tcp flags ! syn,rst,ack counter name "edge_bad_tcp" drop
		tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst | ack) == syn jump edge_syn
	}

	chain edge_syn {
		limit rate over 10000/second burst 20000 packets counter name "edge_syn_global_drop" drop
		ip saddr @edge_peers4 goto edge_peer_syn
		ip6 saddr @edge_peers6 goto edge_peer_syn
		update @syn4 { ip saddr limit rate 100/second burst 200 packets } counter name "edge_syn_admitted" return
		update @syn6 { ip6 saddr & ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:: limit rate 100/second burst 200 packets } counter name "edge_syn_admitted" return
		counter name "edge_syn_source_drop" drop
	}

	chain edge_peer_syn {
		update @syn_peer4 { ip saddr limit rate 5000/second burst 10000 packets } counter name "edge_syn_peer_admitted" return
		update @syn_peer6 { ip6 saddr & ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:: limit rate 5000/second burst 10000 packets } counter name "edge_syn_peer_admitted" return
		counter name "edge_syn_peer_drop" drop
	}

	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state invalid drop
		iif "lo" accept
		icmp type echo-request jump echo_guard
		icmpv6 type echo-request jump echo_guard
		ct state established,related accept
		icmp type { destination-unreachable, time-exceeded, parameter-problem } accept
		icmpv6 type { destination-unreachable, packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem } accept
		icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert } ip6 hoplimit 255 counter name "edge_discovery_accept" accept
		icmpv6 type nd-router-advert ip6 saddr fe80::/10 ip6 hoplimit 255 counter name "edge_discovery_accept" accept
		tcp dport 443 accept
		ip saddr 192.0.2.10 tcp dport 22 ct state new limit rate 6/minute burst 5 packets accept
		ip6 saddr 2001:db8::10 tcp dport 22 ct state new limit rate 6/minute burst 5 packets accept
		counter name "input_denied" jump input_drop
	}

	chain echo_guard {
		limit rate 20/second burst 40 packets counter name "edge_echo_admitted" accept
		counter name "edge_echo_drop" drop
	}

	chain input_drop {
		limit rate 5/minute burst 5 packets counter name "input_logged" log prefix "carnical-in-drop " level info
		drop
	}

	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
	}

	chain output {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
		ct state established,related accept
		ip daddr 169.254.169.254 meta skuid != 0 counter name "egress_imds_drop" jump imds_drop
		ip6 daddr fd00:ec2::254 meta skuid != 0 counter name "egress_imds_drop" jump imds_drop
		meta skuid 990 jump edge_out
		meta skuid { 991, 992, 993, 994 } jump internal_out
	}

	chain edge_out {
		ip daddr { 127.0.0.53, 127.0.0.54 } udp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr { 127.0.0.53, 127.0.0.54 } tcp dport 53 accept
		ip daddr @not_public4 counter name "egress_private_drop" jump edge_private_drop
		ip6 daddr @not_public6 counter name "egress_private_drop" jump edge_private_drop
		fib daddr type local counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump edge_self_drop
		tcp dport { 80, 443 } accept
		counter name "egress_edge_drop" jump edge_egress_drop
	}

	chain internal_out {
		oif "lo" accept
		ip daddr { 127.0.0.53, 127.0.0.54 } udp dport 53 accept
		counter name "egress_internal_drop" jump internal_egress_drop
	}

	chain imds_drop {
		limit rate 10/minute burst 10 packets log prefix "carnical-imds "
		drop
	}

	chain edge_private_drop {
		limit rate 10/minute burst 10 packets log prefix "carnical-edge-private "
		drop
	}

	chain edge_self_drop {
		limit rate 10/minute burst 10 packets log prefix "carnical-edge-self "
		drop
	}

	chain edge_egress_drop {
		limit rate 10/minute burst 10 packets log prefix "carnical-edge-egress "
		drop
	}

	chain internal_egress_drop {
		limit rate 10/minute burst 10 packets log prefix "carnical-internal-egress "
		drop
	}
}
